unsupported_features.comments: JSON does not allow // or /* */ comments.
unsupported_features.nan_or_infinity: JSON numbers cannot use NaN or Infinity.
unsupported_features.single_quoted_strings: JSON strings and object keys require double quotes.
unsupported_features.trailing_commas: JSON does not allow a comma immediately before ] or }.
unsupported_features.unquoted_object_keys: JSON object keys require double quotes.

error_hints.expecting_colon: Check for a missing colon after an object key or a full-width colon.
error_hints.expecting_comma: Check for a missing comma between values or properties.
error_hints.expecting_property_name: Check for a trailing comma or an object key without double quotes.
error_hints.invalid_escape: Use a JSON escape such as \n, \t, \", \\, or \uXXXX.
error_hints.unterminated_string: Close the string with a double quote.
